units.source_text: 土蜘蛛诚惶诚恐的说道：“必须的，必须的，肯定交出来。

en.t: The earth spider said in fear and trembling, "Of course, of course, I will definitely hand it over.

units.source_text: 一切都听您指挥，小公主毫发无损的独自在山洞里呢，请进去带她走吧！”

en.t: I will obey your every command; the little princess is unharmed and alone in the cave, so please go in and take her away!"
